canonical_statement: For an integer n at least 5 and a smooth compactly supported real-valued function u on R^n whose support avoids the origin, the integral of |Delta u|^2 is at least (n(n-4)/4)^2 times the integral of |u(x)|^2/|x|^4.
domain_and_universes: n : Nat with 5 <= n; u : EuclideanSpace Real (Fin n) -> Real, smooth with compact support disjoint from {0}; all objects in Lean universe 0
hypotheses: 0 is not in the support of u
conclusion: integral x, |laplacian u x|^2 >= ((n * (n - 4)) / 4)^2 * integral x, |u x|^2 / ||x||^4, with constants coerced to Real

alternate_encodings.target: completion to the appropriate homogeneous Sobolev space
alternate_encodings.relationship: density extension, not part of the frozen root

excluded_degenerate_cases: Dimensions n <= 4, nonsmooth functions, functions without compact support, and supports meeting the singularity at 0 are outside this root. Rellich-Kondrachov compact embedding is a different theorem.
